messages:
maria: Heads-up — postmortem posted for last night's staged-rollout outage: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/2026-03-20-staged-rollout. Need to track follow-ups around feature-flag gating, fallback behavior, and blast-radius limits.

jonathan: Thanks. Quick asks: who owns the auto-rollback implementation? Also want a clear metric trigger (not just manual). :eyes:

oliver: I can take the metric-side proposal. Suggestion: use error-rate + p50 latency combo over a 3-5m sliding window. e.g. `if errors>2% && p50>300ms for 3m -> trigger rollback`

sam: I'll own the runbook and flag-handoff work. Plan: write a short runbook + implement a kill-switch flag that can be toggled from console within 30s. Target: 2w for runbook + safe flag; 4w to wire automatic rollback with canary metrics.

maria: Sounds good. Can you split into two action items so PM/execs see quick wins? 1) kill-switch + alerting (2w) 2) automatic rollback + tests (4w). Add owners + acceptance criteria.

oliver: Will draft the metric definitions and acceptance tests. I'll put sample queries for dashboards and alert rules in the doc. Example alert: `sum(errors)/sum(requests) > 0.02` over 3m AND `histogram_quantile(0.5, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[3m])) > 0.3`

jonathan: For blast radius: suggested limits per rollout stage: 0.1% of users -> 1% -> 10% with time gates (30m/2h/12h). Also require schema of fallback: on rollback we should automatically pin to previous model/version and quarantine new variant for postmortem.

sam: Action items I'll add to the tracker: 
- A1: kill-switch flag + console action (owner: sam) — due 2026-04-03 — acceptance: toggle reduces traffic to 0 immediately and alerts on toggle.
- A2: metric-based rollback pipeline (owner: oliver) — due 2026-04-17 — acceptance: end-to-end test that flips to previous variant given simulated errors.
- A3: rollout stage limits + gating policy (owner: jonathan) — due 2026-03-31 — acceptance: policy enforced in deployment API and UI.

maria: Please link PRs & experiment docs back to the postmortem doc. I'll be tracking these in the exec follow-up. Also add risk notes for private deployments (customers running behind VPC may need manual ops path).

sre-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync scheduled 2026-03-28 10:00 UTC.

jonathan: Question for infra: do we have a safe rollback path for long-running sessions / KV caches? Need to avoid corruption when switching model variants mid-session.

oliver: Good catch — we need session-scoped compatibility checks and a per-connection flag to drain or continue. I propose: tag sessions with model-version; on rollback, start new sessions with old version and gradually drain old ones (timeout 2m). I'll add this to A2 acceptance tests.

sam: I'll update the runbook to include the session drain steps + a checklist for customer-notify if private.

maria: Thanks everyone. Final ask: add one short synthetic test that can be run from the console to validate rollback logic (devs can run in <5m). That will be part of A2 acceptance.

jonathan: I created the issue tracker: https://issues.redwood/INC-9423 with A1/A2/A3 linked. Please add labels `postmortem-followup`, `rollout-safety`.

sam: Added initial PR template and the runbook stub: https://git.redwood/r/redwood/sre-rollout-runbooks/pull/14 — comments welcome.

maria: We'll do an internal readout at the sync; if no objections, close A1 when kill-switch is validated in staging. Thanks. :thumbsup:
